Keep an eye on him in the mean time.''"<br />"''We keep an eye on ''everyone''.|[[Keldabe Air Traffic Control|Keldabe ATC]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="APM" />}}
The '''Keldabe spaceport''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]],<ref name="APM" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] longstanding [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Overseen by [[Keldabe Air Traffic Control]], the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was the busiest on Mandalore,<ref name="Revelation" /> due to Keldabe's nature as a major hub for the planet<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> and a governmental center for most of [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian space]].<ref name="TEA" /> Many [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] made use of the hundred-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall [[MandalMotors tower|tower]] of the [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] company to manually navigate their way to and around the spaceport.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> The spaceport's landing strips were made of flat [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]].<ref name="Revelation" />

Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-in-hiding [[Jax Pavan]] landed at the Keldabe spaceport when he journeyed to Mandalore in search of information on the whereabouts of his friend and [[Whiplash]] comrade, [[Thi Xon Yimmon]].<ref name="TLJ">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref> Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] established a virtual lockdown on Mandalorian [[Realspace/Legends|space]] which they patrolled with a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Pursuer-class enforcement ship|''Pursuer''-class enforcement ships]]. When presented with a hostile [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], the Mandalorian Protectors forcibly boarded the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], captured its [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], and delivered it to Mandalore's spaceport<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> in Keldabe.<ref name="TEA" /> During the lead up to the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] met with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Scout/Legends|scout]], [[Nom Anor]], at the Keldabe spaceport, all the while under the watchful [[Eye/Legends|eye]] of Keldabe Air Traffic Control.<ref name="APM" />

In [[41 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] was directed to land at the Keldabe spaceport by Keldabe Air Traffic Control when she traveled to Mandalore seeking the aid of Boba Fett. Escorted to the landing strip by a ''[[Bes'uliik]]''-class [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], Solo touched down at the spaceport, where she was met by the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Goran Beviin]] and taken to meet Fett at the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in Keldabe. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of Solo's visit, the spaceport was packed with numerous Mandalorians arriving on Mandalore from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], summoned by the ''Mand'alor'' in order to bolster the recovery of the Mandalorian homeworld in the wake of the Yuuzhan Vong's [[Battle of Mandalore (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] on the planet [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] prior.<ref name="Revelation" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Keldabe spaceport first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2006]] [[EBook|e-novella]] ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="APM" /> Traviss later featured the spaceport in her ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'', released [[February 26]], [[2008]],<ref name="Revelation" /> and her ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel, [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], published [[September 16]], [[2008]].<ref name="O66" /> The Keldabe spaceport later made a brief appearance in the novel [[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']], written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]], and published on [[February 26]], [[2013]].<ref name="TLJ" />
